recognize_zh: 這是間期細胞核（DAPI 藍色）的螢光原位雜交（FISH）影像：可見一個單獨紅色訊號、一個單獨綠色訊號，以及一個紅綠緊鄰融合的黃色訊號（1R1G1F），在 CML 的 BCR::ABL1 探針中代表存在一個融合基因。
features: Interphase FISH of a single nucleus counterstained with DAPI (blue)
One isolated red signal and one isolated green (aqua-green) signal
One juxtaposed red-green fusion signal (yellow/overlapping) at the lower right
Signal pattern 1R1G1F, consistent with one BCR::ABL1 fusion using a dual-color single-fusion probe design
describe_en: Interphase fluorescence in situ hybridization image of a DAPI-counterstained nucleus shows one separate red signal, one separate green signal and one juxtaposed red-green fusion signal (1R1G1F). With a dual-color BCR/ABL1 probe, this pattern indicates one normal ABL1 allele, one normal BCR allele and one BCR::ABL1 fusion, consistent with t(9;22)(q34;q11.2). A dual-fusion probe would instead be expected to show two fusion signals in a typical translocation, so the probe design should be confirmed before interpretation. Findings support a diagnosis of chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR::ABL1-positive, in the appropriate context.
